mcqs.q: Which Bolshevik slogan summarised Lenin's April Theses?
options: Peace, Land, Bread
Workers of the world unite
Liberte, egalite, fraternite
Better dead than red

mcqs.q: What was the immediate cause of the February Revolution?
options: German invasion
Bread shortages in Petrograd
Lenin's return from Switzerland
Kerensky's offensive

mcqs.q: Why did Britain pursue appeasement in the 1930s?
options: Victorian prisons abolished hard labour and corporal punishment.
Britain was militarily unprepared, traumatised by WWI losses, sympathetic to revising Versailles, and feared communism more than Nazism.
Because Britain had no army at all in the 1930s.
Because Chamberlain was a coward and admired Hitler.

mcqs.q: How did prison purposes change in the 19th century?
options: Victorian prisons were created to rehabilitate prisoners kindly.
Prisons shifted from holding before trial or transportation to punishment and reform via the Separate and Silent systems, influenced by Fry and the 1823 and 1865 Prison Acts.
The Schlieffen Plan failed because it tried to invade Russia first.
Victorian prisons abolished hard labour and corporal punishment.
